_readme: TUITION AND COURSE PROMOTIONS
This is the only file you need to edit to manage advertisements.
After editing, run build.cmd.
HOW TO ADD A NEW ADVERTISEMENT
Copy the template below into the "ads" list and fill it in. Keep the
commas between entries. The last entry must NOT end with a comma.
"id": "a-short-unique-name",
"status": "active",
"featured": false,
"advertiser": "Name of the teacher or institute",
"courseTitle": "What is being offered",
"subject": "English",
"audience": "Grade 10 and 11",
"mode": "Online",
"location": "Online",
"schedule": "Saturdays, 9.00 a.m. to 11.00 a.m.",
"description": "Two or three plain sentences.",
"phone": "",
"whatsapp": "",
"link": "",
"image": "",
"imageAlt": ""
THE FIELDS
id           Any short name, used only inside this file. Must be unique.
status       draft | scheduled | active | expired
Only 'active' advertisements are shown to visitors, and
only while today's date is inside the start and expiry
dates. Set 'draft' to hide one without deleting it.
featured     true puts the advertisement at the top with a Featured
label. false is the normal position.
startDate    The first day it should appear.   Format: YYYY-MM-DD
expiryDate   The last day it should appear.    Format: YYYY-MM-DD
For a Weekly Listing, set expiryDate 7 days after
startDate. For a Monthly Listing, 30 days after.
advertiser   The teacher, lecturer or institute name.
courseTitle  The course or class being advertised.
subject      Used by the subject filter.
audience     Grade, examination or target group. Used by the filter.
mode         'Online' or 'In person'. Used by the filter.
location     A town or 'Online'. Used by the location filter.
schedule     Days and times, in plain words.
description  A short paragraph. Keep it factual.
phone        Leave empty unless the advertiser has agreed to publish it.
whatsapp     International form, e.g. 94704395240. Leave empty if not
agreed. A WhatsApp button appears only when this is set.
link         Registration or enquiry page. Leave empty if there is none.
image        Poster path, e.g. downloads/promotions/name.jpg
Posters are shown whole and are never cropped, so no text
on the poster can be cut off. Leave empty for no image.
imageAlt     What the poster says, for screen readers and for anyone
whose connection does not load images.
HOW EXPIRY WORKS
This website is a set of plain files with no server behind it, so
nothing can run at midnight to retire an advertisement. Expiry is
handled in two places instead:
1. When you run build.cmd, the build works out each advertisement's
real state from its dates and writes it into the page.
2. In the visitor's browser, any advertisement whose expiry date has
passed is hidden using the visitor's own clock.
So an advertisement stops being shown on the correct day even if the
site has not been rebuilt since. Rebuild when convenient to remove it
from the page source as well.
CHANGING THE ADVERTISING PACKAGES
Edit the "packages" list below. To publish real prices later, replace
the "price" value on each one. Leave it as it is to keep showing
'Contact us for current rates'.

packages.name: Weekly Listing
packages.summary: A standard listing in the main directory for one week. Suitable for a short course, a workshop or a single intake.

packages.name: Monthly Listing
packages.summary: A standard listing for a full month. Suitable for regular weekly classes and term-long courses.

packages.name: Featured Promotion
packages.summary: A more prominent position at the top of the directory, with a Featured label, for the period agreed with you.

_offersReadme: RCF's OWN OFFERS - not third-party advertisements
The "offers" list below holds discounts and promotions on RCF's own
products. These are NOT paid advertisements, so they never carry a
Sponsored label. Third-party advertisements go in "ads" above.
publications  - offers on RCF Publications books and ebooks
premium       - offers on Premium Resource collections
academy       - offers on RCF Online Academy courses
